environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 instances in a VPC (10.0.0.0/16). Sidekiq workers run on the same instances and have unrestricted outbound network access. The application's internal metadata service is accessible at 169.254.169.254. Internal microservices (user-service, billing-service, admin-api) are accessible on the 10.0.x.x subnet without authentication from within the VPC. DNS resolution is performed by the default VPC resolver with no filtering. Workers process jobs 2-5 seconds after enqueue.

config.network: VPC 10.0.0.0/16, no egress filtering, no DNS firewall
